verifications.claim: Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged, government-backed, child-focused investment accounts authorized by the 2025 "One Big Beautiful Bill Act".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'tax-advantaged IRA designed specifically for kids... established as part of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act'; R3: 'The One Big Beautiful Bill permits Trump Accounts'; R6: 'authorized in law by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) of 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm tax-advantaged status, child focus, government involvement via seed money, and authorization by the named 2025 act.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts provide a $1,000 federal seed contribution for children born 2025–2028.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '$1,000 pilot program... for children... born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028'; R3: 'initial $1,000 deposit from the government... born after December 31, 2024 and before January 1, 2029'; R5: 'one-time $1,000 government seed contribution... born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match on $1,000 federal contribution specifically for children born 2025-2028 across sources.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts allow $5,000 in annual contributions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Individuals and employers can contribute up to a total of $5,000 per child per year'; R3: 'parents to contribute up to an additional $5,000 per year'; R5: 'up to $5,000 annually'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state $5,000 annual contribution limit.

verifications.claim: Funds in Trump Accounts are accessible to the beneficiary at age 18.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'no withdrawals... until the year the child turns 18. Beginning in the year the child turns 18'; R3: 'Deposits cannot be withdrawn prior to the beneficiary turning 18 years old'; R5: 'Funds may not be withdrawn before the child turns 18... After age 18, standard IRA rules'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm accessibility begins at age 18, treated as traditional IRA thereafter.

verifications.claim: Any child under 18 with a Social Security number can have a Trump Account.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'your child must have a Social Security number and be under 18 years old'; R5: 'Any child under 18 with a valid Social Security number may open a Trump Account'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements match eligibility criteria exactly.

verifications.claim: A $1,000 one-time tax-exempt pilot program contribution is exclusively for children born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '$1,000 pilot program... children who are U.S. citizens and born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028'; R5: 'one-time $1,000 contribution... child born between calendar year 2025 and 2028'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify pilot program details, dates, and exclusivity; government contributions are pre-tax.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts allow up to $5,000 in annual contributions per child.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'up to a total of $5,000 per child per year'; R3: 'up to $5,000 per year'; R5: 'up to $5,000 annually'; R6: 'Up to $5,000 per year per child'
verifications.reasoning: Precise match on per-child annual limit.
